info.name: TwinTrack Accounts API
info.description: Every route of the Master API, with tests. Run it in Postman against a running API, or with `npm run test:postman`, which starts its own copy. Update this file in the same change as any route.

item.name: Accounts
item.description: Vendors, bills, payments, receipts, bank accounts, invoices, payroll and evidence. Kamrul runs Accounts day to day; Rumana, the finance lead, approves.

item.name: A category code in use is refused

exec: pm.test('shows the bank number to someone allowed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().bankAccountNumber).to.eql("0011223344"));

item.name: Finance lead can not add a vendor
Accountant saves the company bank details
Finance lead reads the company bank details
Accountant pays part of the bill
Paying more than is owed is refused
Reversing a bill with payments is refused

exec: pm.test('is back to the opening balance', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().currentBalance).to.eql(100000));

item.name: Accountant records a draft to delete
Accountant starts uploading a scan to the bill
Finance lead lists the bill's evidence
Finance lead gets a link to the scan
Admin adds a client to bill
Team lead files a project under the client
Accountant bills the project with a custom line
A sent invoice can not be deleted
Accountant counts it against the invoice
Reversing an allocated receipt is refused
A second run for the month is refused
Accountant marks one person's pay sent
Accountant makes a run to delete
